coverage.selection: prefix; samples outside this interval are not inspected

acoustic_diagnostics.normalization: none; caller-supplied decoded PCM; 1.0 is full-scale sample amplitude

spectrum.units: FS^2/Hz; FS is decoded sample full-scale amplitude
spectrum.chart_reduction: contiguous native bins grouped by arithmetic means; sum(chart_PSD * chart_bin_bandwidth) preserves native integrated power
spectrum.band_integration: sum(PSD * bin_width) over bin centers in each band; empty bands are null
spectrum.detrending: per-channel per-frame mean removed before windowing
spectrum.channel_aggregation: arithmetic mean of channel powers; no waveform downmix

frequency_response.reason: A lone recording does not identify system transfer response; use synchronized known input/output in measure_frequency_response.

distortion.rms_reference: 20*log10(rms / 1.0); a full-scale peak sine is approximately -3.0103 dB
distortion.true_peak: NOT_MEASURED; sample peaks do not establish inter-sample peaks
distortion.limitation: Near-rail samples and crest factor neither prove clipping nor measure THD. Prior clipping can be hidden by later gain reduction.
distortion.calibration_route: measure_coherent_sine_thd requires explicit calibration_signal=True and a known coherent fundamental

timbre.flatness_definition: geometric/arithmetic mean of power; floor is 1e-12 times per-frame mean power
timbre.limitation: Descriptors change with arrangement, equalization, level envelope, window, and bandwidth; no identity probability is inferred.

tempo.method: positive log-magnitude spectral flux; local-mean suppression; overlap-normalized autocorrelation; interior-peak parabolic lag interpolation
tempo.score_definition: cosine similarity of onset-envelope portions at a lag; not a probability
tempo.lag_interpolation_policy: Three-point quadratic interpolation refines an interior local maximum by at most half a lag frame; the measured integer-lag periodicity score and ranking are retained.
tempo.lag_quantization_interpretation: Integer-grid half-step is a resolution diagnostic, not a confidence interval or a calibrated post-interpolation error bound.
tempo.ambiguity: Half/double tempo and other metrical levels may describe the same recording.
tempo.validation: Real-music tempo and beat accuracy NOT RUN; no beat tracking or variable-tempo map.

decode_receipt.coverage_caveat: Only the decoded first-stream window is measured; source duration may use a different codec convention.
decode_receipt.full_scale_basis: 1.0 decoded PCM sample amplitude; no acoustic SPL calibration

limitations: A valid receipt does not authenticate a backend run, establish rights or validate transcription accuracy.
Mix and separated-vocal hypotheses share source evidence and are not independent corroboration.
Decoder probabilities and lexical agreement are not calibrated probabilities of correct sung words.
Absent detected vocal activity may reflect a detector miss; flagged text is preserved, not silently deleted.
Existing Unicode word tokenization is not language-specific segmentation.
This adapter performs no note, chord, performer-identity or musical-score transcription.
Absence of a retrieved match does not establish that two works are unrelated.
The review cannot establish facts about material outside the actually searched scope.
Different components measure different properties; their percentages are not interchangeable probabilities.
Shared features and separate group names do not establish statistical independence.
Existing control comparisons do not exclude every common-feature or chance explanation.
Scientific acceptance and calibration require scope-matched held-out evidence.
